[Act: partnership
 Chapter: Incoming and Outgoing Partners
 Section: 33::Expulsion of a partner.
]


(1) Apartner may not be expelled from a firm by any majority of the partners, save in the exercise in good faith of powers conferred by contract between the partners.
(2)The provisions of sub-sections (2), (3)and (4)of section 32 shall apply to an expelled partner as if he were a retired partner.
